title: Hermitese
description: This resource pack adds a language with hermitcraft and hermitcraft-adjacent references.
body:
This resource pack adds hermitcraft and hermitcraft-adjacent references to the game through a new language and sound changes.

!Please remember, for most of this pack's changes to take effect, you must enable the "Hermitese" language in the in-game languages menu.

This pack and its creators are in no way associated with or endorsed by the Hermitcraft SMP. This is entirely a fan creation, nothing more.
